rows.grounds: locative plural of anukta, referring to positions not explicitly spoken
causative optative third singular of yuj
ablative adverb indicating origin in the middle of the koshta

items.question: When positions are left unspoken, should their names still be joined from the middle of the koshta?
premises: Names are joined from koshta middle.
items.inference: Therefore unspoken positions receive names joined from the middle of the koshta.
uncertainties: The exact ritual referent of koshta in this context is not specified.
items.plain_english: Even for positions not explicitly named, join their names from the middle of the koshta.
